newsitem.title: USA: Sungard Data unit part of $6 bln contract.
newsitem.headline: Sungard Data unit part of $6 bln contract.

text.p: SunGard Computer Services has been awarded a contract by the Federal Computer Acquisition Center of the General Services Administration for data center outsourcing to government-wide agencies.

Under the award SunGard said it is one of three prime contractors that will provide up to $6 billion in "Virtual Data Center" services over the next ten years. The outsourcing initiative was launched by the Federal Systems Integration and Management Center.
SunGard Computer Services Inc is the outsourcing unit of SunGard Data Systems Inc, and is a provider of mainframe, client/server, and network support services.
